title: Accessibility statement
body:
I want this site to be usable by everyone, and I'm aiming to meet the **Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA**.

## What's built in

* A "Skip to main content" link and clear page landmarks for screen readers.
* Full keyboard navigation with visible focus outlines.
* Display options to enlarge text, switch to a dark theme or use a high-contrast theme.
* Respect for your device's "reduce motion" and dark-mode settings.
* Form fields with visible labels, clear error messages and spoken status updates.
* Colour combinations chosen for readable contrast.
* Text alternatives for images.



## Feedback

If something doesn't work for you, please let me know through the [contact form](#/contact) and I'll do my best to fix it.
